title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Access open-sourced Power BI apps
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) open-sources Power BI apps for sales, purchasing, and projects, joining previously open-sourced finance, inventory, and manufacturing apps. Organizations can now fully customize semantic models and reports to match their business processes and KPIs without starting from scratch.
key_points: All standard Business Central Power BI apps are now open-sourced, providing complete code access
Open-sourced apps available: Finance, Inventory, Inventory Valuation, Manufacturing, Subscription Billing, and Sustainability in BC26; Sales, Purchasing, and Projects added in BC27
Developers can access source code through PowerBIReports in Business Central or by adding dependencies in app.json, then edit and customize in Power BI
Customization saves development time by building on ready-made models rather than starting from scratch

objects.name: Power BI Report embeddings for Dynamics 365 Business Central

quotes.text: Instead of starting from scratch, you can build on high-quality, ready-made models and visualizations, saving significant development time and effort.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the practical business value of having pre-built, customizable templates rather than developing independently
